instruction: Adversarial review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020D1 (SCP self-dogfood wrapper) at completeness/governance lens. (2) Wrapper pins at a 40-char commit SHA (verify the actual pin SHA exists in the SCP repo's main history — it should be `9820489fa83f64d04f641d20e99d3933cefbb04a`, the 020K merge commit). (3) Branch protection on main does NOT include `scp/policy-check` as a required check yet (this is post-merge state — the check would be added at 020D2). (5) Wrapper file follows the canonical adopter shape per WP-SCP-020 020H part 3 (ADOPT-001 §12) — verify the YAML structure matches the canonical example: `name: policy-check`, `on: pull_request: branches: [main]`, `permissions: contents: read, statuses: write`, single job named `policy-check` using the cross-repo SHA-pin, Renovate marker comment present. (8) The slice does NOT inadvertently touch any non-wrapper files (e.g., does not modify the reusable policy-check.yml itself, does not modify any rego rules, does not add new tests, does not change schemas). It is a pure additive slice introducing only the wrapper file (plus the dispatch evidence dir). (9) Cross-repo references to `jrnb2024/standards-control-plane` use the correct repo name (with trailing dash) — verify this matches the actual GitHub repo. (10) The slice's risk profile is accurately marked HIGH in DISPATCH-NOTE.md (first real-PR self-gate), and the expected CI fixpoint dance is acknowledged. Any spec-vs-implementation drift, missing acceptance criterion, or undocumented assumption is a finding. Per WP-SCP-022 §4.3 fixpoint criteria. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON.
